title: Equipment state engine default rules
description: Timing defaults the downtime state engine applies to every state/rate signal unless an equipment-class or asset `state_rules` row (1.10 migration 0008) overrides them. Spec DT01 (rules effective-dated with preview), DT02 (5 s debounce, 60 s micro-stop, 10 s restart confirmation, staleness = max(60 s, 3 x sample interval); states outside schedule detected but excluded from the OEE denominator), DT03 (close at first qualifying recovery; micro-stops -> performance, stops >= threshold -> availability), DT04 (stale/bad -> Unknown). Decision D04 (micro-stop). Consumed by sub-phase 1.10.

debounceSeconds.description: A stop candidate becomes a confirmed Stopped segment only after the condition has held this long; effective start is the first qualifying observation, the confirmation delay is not added (DT02, DT03).

microStopSeconds.description: Confirmed stops shorter than this become micro-stop events (oee_component performance); longer stops become downtime events (availability) - never both (DT03). Must equal `oee_policy.body.microStopSeconds`.

restartConfirmSeconds.description: Running must hold this long before a stop is closed; the stop end is the first qualifying recovery observation (DT02, DT03).

staleSeconds.description: Minimum staleness window. maxStale = max(staleSeconds, staleSampleFactor x signal sample interval); after it the segment closes provisionally and Unknown opens (DT02, DT04).

staleSampleFactor.description: Multiplier on the signal's nominal sample interval for the staleness window (DT02).

monitorOutsideSchedule.description: Detect and store state segments outside scheduled time (flagged `outside_schedule`); they never enter the OEE denominator (DT02, KPI02). False discards observations outside the calendar.

gapPolicyMaxGapSeconds.description: Longest Running gap between two consecutive confirmed stops that the correlator may bridge into one impact occurrence (SRC02). 0 = never bridge; every qualifying recovery closes the occurrence (DT03).
